name: averie-cook
description: Averie 做饭档案站 — 做过的 / 想做的 / 想吃的

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build:pages && npx wrangler pages dev
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && npx wrangler pages deploy
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npx tsx --test web/src/lib/*.test.ts scripts/export-public-snapshot.test.mjs && bash scripts/verify-recipe-leak.sh --snapshot-only
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w api && npx tsc --noEmit -p functions/tsconfig.json
